assignedAssertion.assertion: Given a principal and bigint value exceeding JavaScript's safe integer range, When tool/client/Python/Swift DTOs round-trip it, Then UUID actor mapping, canonical decimal revision/generation/sequence/watermark, focusGeneration UUID and immutable UTF-8 observation quote remain exact.

authoritativeShapes.specOwner: Hermes common agent/tool context; trusted identity mapping belongs to protected authentication/ingress
authoritativeShapes.source: /Users/johansardar/Documents/Codex/personal-assistant-harness/specs/hermes-config.md §5.1; specs/CONTRACTS.md common identifiers and identity.principals owner row
authoritativeShapes.requiredFields: actorId: PrincipalId; recordRevision: Revision; generation: Revision. Protected ingress maps opaque Better Auth user text through identity.principals to the UUID PrincipalId before RunContext construction.
authoritativeShapes.currentGap: Neither PrincipalId nor RunContext appears in current TypeScript contract sources or generated Python DTOs. AttentionSnapshot.ownerId is not evidence of actor mapping.

authoritativeShapes.requiredFields: RunRef has runId: UUID, principalId: PrincipalId, profile, sessionId, taskId, turnId, contractId, contractVersion and generation: Revision. Review carries that RunRef and evidenceHighWater: Revision among its review fields; ReviewResult is reviewed-with-Review or pending-with-RunRef/reason/retryAt.
authoritativeShapes.currentGap: RunRef, Review and ReviewResult are absent from @toy/contracts and generated Python. The specified RunAdmission.admit and TurnReview.checkStop/review/get owner interfaces also have no current implementation. RunRef.principalId and RunContext.actorId are distinct specified fields; neither attention ownerId nor a hand-built sample proves their mapping. Review.evidenceHighWater does not replace the distinct IngestReceipt sequence/watermark fields.

authoritativeShapes.requiredFields: id: UUID; focusGeneration: UUID; revision: UInt64String; commitmentId: UUID; objective; startsAt; endsAt; state; ruleSetId; policyHash.
authoritativeShapes.currentGap: No FocusSession DTO exists in current @toy/contracts or generated Python. AttentionFocusViewV1.cycleId is a different domain field and cannot substitute for focusGeneration.

authoritativeShapes.specOwner: Activity-Focus ActivitySource; immutable observation references are Life Store owned
authoritativeShapes.requiredFields: receiptId, deviceId, streamId, committedThroughSeq: UInt64String, committedEventIds, observationRefs, committedWatermark: UInt64String, serverTime, nextUploadAfterMs. committedThroughSeq and committedWatermark are separate values.
authoritativeShapes.currentGap: No IngestReceipt DTO exists in current @toy/contracts or generated Python. A Revision-only sample does not cover either missing sequence or watermark boundary.

authoritativeShapes.requiredFields: observationRef: life://observation/<UUID>; optional documentId: UUID; optional paired byteFrom/byteTo decimal offsets; optional quote. The retained UTF-8 byte span must delimit the exact quote and the referenced observation is immutable.
authoritativeShapes.currentGap: The TypeScript schema and generated Python shape exist, but the Zod schema only validates the reference and scalar field shapes; it does not require paired offsets/document binding or verify quote bytes against retained evidence. A source type alone cannot prove archive immutability.

currentSourceFindings.primitives: packages/contracts/src/primitives.ts has UUID, canonical decimal Revision and bounded UInt64String string schemas. Those preserve values above 9007199254740991 as strings, but they do not create the absent RunContext, FocusSession or IngestReceipt DTO boundaries.
currentSourceFindings.attentionAliasesRejected: AttentionSnapshot.ownerId and AttentionFocusViewV1.cycleId remain their own canonical fields. Existing Attention item revisions/page watermarks do not represent the distinct RunContext generation, IngestReceipt sequence/watermark pair, or FocusSession.focusGeneration.
currentSourceFindings.identityOwner: CONTRACTS.md assigns identity.principals to protected authentication/ingress. A fixture UUID in actorId would prove UUID representation only; it would not prove principal-to-actor resolution unless the public protected mapping owner supplies the resolved value.
currentSourceFindings.pythonBoundary: python/toy_contracts/generated.py uses TypedDict and NewType(str) shapes. They provide static typing, not runtime JSON validation. Python equality/JSON readback can prove decimal-string and UTF-8 representation preservation; runtime validation must be attributed to an actual validator, not TypedDict.
currentSourceFindings.existingCliRoute: AT-hermes-config-50 is present in generated-probe-registry.ts but absent from authored tests/registry.yaml. Existing toy probe.run/probe.show routes use ReplayEnvironment.runRegisteredProbe and FixtureProbe. The ReplayEnvironment has no AT50 branch today. RegisteredProbeInput carries probe identity/case/request ID, while CheckView carries only bounded summary strings and evidence links; neither is a DTO payload/readback API.
currentSourceFindings.checkAndMap: No semantically exact registered check ID exists for DTO round-trip. read.attention is owned by Attention and routes to attention.snapshot at R1, so it cannot stand for this R0 assertion. FEATURE-MAP.md currently lists AT50 under the broad specified hermes-config row without an implemented DTO route.
currentSourceFindings.publicOwners: Current Hermes public exports ModelRoute/auth/profile probes only; Attention, Client and LifeStore public entries are stubs. The specified RunAdmission/TurnReview, RunContext, FocusSession, IngestReceipt and retained-observation owner paths therefore are not available as current public DTO owners.

minimumReachableUnit.smallestCanonicalPrerequisite: Publish the already-specified PrincipalId, RunContext, RunRef, Review/ReviewResult, FocusSession and IngestReceipt shapes through the existing @toy/contracts schema source and generator; use the specified RunAdmission and TurnReview owners when exercising RunRef/Review rather than fabricating values. Reuse the current ObservationEvidenceRef type, adding only its specified paired-offset/document validation; do not add a composite probe DTO or alias ownerId/cycleId/Revision into missing fields.

boundedSteps.action: Expose the spec-defined PrincipalId/common context and publish the exact evidence constraints through the canonical schema inventory and existing generator. Keep Life Store retained-text verification at the Life Store owner boundary.

Publish the already-written FocusSession and IngestReceipt interfaces from activity-focus.md §§5.2–5.3 and RunRef/Review/ReviewResult from self-improvement.md §3. Preserve separate focusGeneration, revision, committedThroughSeq and committedWatermark fields, plus RunRef.principalId/generation and Review.evidenceHighWater. Generate TypeScript and Python; Swift generation/compiler remains deferred to R3.

Register one unfiltered AT-hermes-config-50 manifest; add the narrowly scoped contracts.dto-roundtrip CheckView ID owned by contracts with nextCommandId probe.run; dispatch that exact probe through the existing ReplayEnvironment route and allow only that check ID/owner through FixtureProbe. Regenerate the probe registry through the existing generator and map the existing CLI path. The check ID is a CLI receipt identity, not a new DTO or product protocol.

At the assigned CLI rung, exercise the specified public RunAdmission/TurnReview and Activity-Focus DTO owners through the one registered unfiltered probe; round-trip their generated TypeScript schemas and Python wire representations using the same canonical values. Assert RunContext.actorId and RunRef.principalId from the fixture mapping, >2^53 decimal revision/generation values, separate IngestReceipt committedThroughSeq/committedWatermark, FocusSession.focusGeneration UUID, exact UTF-8 quote bytes, unfiltered run, saved probe.show status, and stack teardown. Python TypedDict is a static annotation; its JSON round-trip is representation evidence, not runtime validation.

checkIdRoute.reason: The current check registry has no matching check. read.attention/attention.snapshot is a different owner and R1 route. FixtureProbe currently rejects checks outside its explicit probe/check/owner pairs.

The AT's principal-to-actor predicate remains pending until the protected identity.principals owner supplies a public fixture mapping/readback; ownerId cannot stand in for either field.
